name: Alicia Mignano
office: Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District, Member of the Board of Education

items.text: Alicia Mignano is the president of the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education, first elected in 2022. She is a business owner.

sentences.text: Alicia Mignano is the president of the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education, first elected in 2022.

items.text: Her campaign says she visited every school in the district to understand student and teacher needs, and focused on improving outcomes for multilingual learners and protecting early reading intervention teachers from budget cuts. She voted to endorse a $495 annual parcel tax measure to fund schools. In 2024, she opposed a transition to voting districts, stating that the community already elects representation from protected classes. In 2023, she voted to develop a communications plan for a proposed Civic Auditorium project.
